items.title: Shift-queued buildings
items.text: Hold Shift while placing buildings to queue several in a row. Each queued site shows its footprint and a build-queue symbol, and the worker moves on to the next one when it finishes.

items.title: Rally points and production queue
items.text: A rally point set on a building under construction sends its builder there when it is done. With a group selected, a queued unit goes to the building with the least work waiting, so queued units alternate.

items.title: Auto control groups
items.text: Finished buildings and trained units join the control group you choose for each kind. Set the rules in the mod settings.

items.title: Game Mode: classic balance
items.text: The lobby has a Game Mode selector, with classic balance as an option. Replays and live watching follow the mode the game was played in.

items.title: Automatic updates
items.text: The game now installs core and plugin updates at launch. Turn it off in the mod settings if you would rather update by hand.
